textStyles.name: display-xl
textStyles.usage: The one hero line on a page.

textStyles.name: title-1
textStyles.usage: Page titles in products; dialog heroes.

textStyles.name: micro
textStyles.usage: Badges, keyboard keys, counters. Never sentences.

durations.name: popover
durations.usage: Tooltips, menus, popovers; exits of anything.

durations.name: sheet
durations.usage: Sheets and drawers that follow a drag (with ease-drawer).

durations.name: reveal
durations.usage: The one-time blur rise on page entrance and scroll.

eases.name: out
eases.usage: Anything entering, leaving or responding. The default.

eases.name: in-out
eases.usage: Something moving or morphing between two places on screen.

eases.name: drawer
eases.usage: Sheets and drawers that follow a drag.

eases.name: spring
eases.usage: Things that snap into place: toggles, drag release. Never menus or text.

moves.name: unfold
moves.what: Menus and popovers grow out of the control that opened them.

moves.name: focus pull
moves.what: The page behind a dialog softens while the dialog comes into focus.

moves.name: glide
moves.what: The tab indicator moves between tabs on the in-out curve.

moves.name: bloom
moves.what: A button blooms once in the halation color when its work is done.

moves.name: stack
moves.what: Toasts stack with depth and fan out when pointed at.

moves.name: rise
moves.what: Content arrives in reading order out of a soft blur, once.
